stages.source-validation: Checking each source record against the adapter's schema (XSD or JSON Schema). A failure is a finding, never a refusal.
stages.lift: Reading the source document into triples the adapter's queries can ask about.
stages.index: Building the compiled executor's index over the lifted triples. The general evaluator builds none.
stages.mapping: Running the adapter's mapping queries on each record. (Specification stage: transform.)
stages.records: Building each record's graph from the mapping's output, naming its versions and writing their arrivals. (Specification stage: name versions, write arrivals.)
stages.document-table: Running the adapter's document-table query, which links a record to any other record, in the document or not. (Specification stage: link records.)
stages.accounting: Working out, against the adapter's accounting file, what became of each element and attribute of each source record.
stages.dataset: Assembling the dataset each record's queries run over.
stages.output-validation: Checking the output graph against the vocabulary's SHACL shapes. (Specification stage: check, validate.)
stages.findings: Running the adapter's findings queries to find what the source record got wrong or left out. (Specification stage: findings.)
stages.unresolved-addresses: Finding the references to records the document does not hold, which keep their computed names.
stages.detect: Running the adapter's detect query, which reports whether the adapter reads this document and never routes it.
stages.summary: Writing the document and the import into the graph.
stages.serialising: Writing the graph and the findings out as Turtle or N-Triples.
stages.unaccounted: Seconds of the profiled convert that no stage accounts for.

rows.convert/first: Seconds the first convert of a fresh process takes, unprofiled: what a caller opening an adapter and converting once waits.
rows.convert/second: Seconds a second convert of the same document takes in the same process, unprofiled: the warm cost.
rows.convert/profiled: Seconds of the one convert run with profiling on, from which the stage and query rows are read.
rows.memory.grow/first: How many times the wasm memory grew during the first convert.
rows.memory.grow/second: How many times the wasm memory grew during the second convert.
rows.wasm-memory/first: Bytes of wasm memory held once the first convert is done.
rows.wasm-memory/second: Bytes of wasm memory held once the second convert is done.
rows.rss: Peak resident memory of the process over both converts, in bytes.
rows.records-per-second: Source records converted per second by the first convert.
rows.records: Source records the Bridge found in the document and converted.
rows.index-built: 1 when the compiled executor built its index, 0 when it did not.
rows.output-bytes/graph: Bytes of the output graph as Turtle.
rows.output-bytes/findings: Bytes of the findings as Turtle.
rows.fallbacks: Record executions the general evaluator answered because a query was not compiled or a compiled plan gave up.
rows.query-time/*: Seconds one of the adapter's queries took, summed over every record it ran on, in the profiled convert.
rows.query-rows/*: Rows one of the adapter's queries returned, summed over every record it ran on.
rows.stage/*: Seconds one stage of the profiled convert took.
rows.output/graph: Quads in the output graph, with the SHA-256 of its canonical N-Quads (RDFC-1.0). Equal digests mean the same graph up to blank node names.
rows.output/findings: Quads in the findings, with the SHA-256 of their canonical N-Quads (RDFC-1.0). Equal digests mean the same findings up to blank node names.
rows.load: Seconds to read the adapter's and the vocabulary's files, describe the adapter and prepare it, with the wasm already running.
rows.load/read-files: Seconds of the load spent reading files from disk.
rows.load/prepare: Seconds of the load spent describing the adapter and preparing it: parsing and compiling its queries, schemas and shapes.
rows.load/missing-files: Files the load asked for that the folder did not have.
rows.boot/read-wasm: Seconds to read the Bridge's wasm file from disk.
rows.boot/compile-wasm: Seconds to compile the Bridge's wasm module.
rows.boot/instantiate-wasm: Seconds to instantiate the compiled module, which runs its start function.
rows.timeout/*: The input did not finish in its time limit, in the phase named; the value is the limit in seconds.
rows.refused/*: The Bridge refused the input with this kind of failure.

inputs.ccda-entries-x10: The C-CDA medications-and-results example with its entries repeated 10 times: one document, 1 record.
inputs.ccda-entries-x50: The C-CDA medications-and-results example with its entries repeated 50 times: one document, 1 record.
inputs.ccda-synthea-10y: Ten years of one Synthea person as a single C-CDA document: 1 record.
inputs.fhir-r4-lab-pull-3000: A pull of 3,000 lab results in one FHIR R4 searchset Bundle: 3,004 records.
inputs.fhir-r4-synthea-10y-trimmed: The trimmed ten-year Synthea record of the demo hospitals as a FHIR R4 Bundle: 647 records.
inputs.fhir-r4-synthea-lifetime: The lifetime Synthea record of one person, a 51 MB FHIR R4 Bundle: 16,833 records.
